name: Japan
about: Prices come from Japan's Retail Price Survey by the Statistics Bureau (Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications) for the Tokyo ward area. Rounds before 2010 use the yearly average; later rounds use January. Each item only goes back as far as its package size stayed the same.
